links.outcome: LLM output changes when patient gender identity (transgender vs cisgender) is varied in word association and appointment allocation
links.effect: Consistent bias in appearance, risk, and veracity categories with stronger negative associations for transgender people; in allocation, transgender candidates favored for STI and mental health, cisgender for gynecology and breast care.
links.quote: Our results show consistent bias in categories such as appearance, risk, and veracity, indicating stronger negative associations with transgender individuals.

screen.reason: Empirically benchmarks implicit bias in LLMs on word association and a simulated healthcare appointment allocation task without testing a specific deployment guardrail or practice.
